## Welcome

We look forward to your visit!

PLEASE NOTE: MAD's hours are noon to 8 pm on Wednesdays. The Museum will be closed Thu, Nov 26, and open on Fri, Nov 27.

MAD admissions are Pay What You Wish from 5 to 8 pm on the first Wednesday of every month. Pay-What-You-Wish tickets may only be purchased in person.

## AFFILIATIONS AND COMMUNITY PARTNERS

MAD offers complimentary or discounted General Admission to active US military or veterans, people with disabilities and their accompanying caregivers/nurses, EBT/SNAP benefit cardholders, and our museum colleagues. For a complete list, please read our Affiliations and Community Partners section below.

## **ACCESSIBILITY**

MAD strives to be a welcoming experience for visitors of all abilities. Information about the Museum’s building accessibility is available in our Accessibility section below. [Learn more](https://madmuseum.org/about/access-and-accessibility) about our accessibility programming and services.

## TOUR OPTIONS

MAD offers both public docent walkthroughs and private guided tours.

**Join a Docent Tour**

Free docent tours take place on Wed at 2:30 pm and Thu–Sun at 11:30 am and 2:30 pm.

To join, meet the docent in the lobby five minutes prior to the tour start time.

**Book a Private Guided Tour** 

Book a private tour of [*Nike: Form Follows Motion*](https://madmuseum.org/exhibition/nike-form-follows-motion) and enjoy an exclusive, in-depth walkthrough with the exhibition curator or an expert guide. MAD private tours are creative learning experiences designed to get people talking, sharing perspectives, and connecting on a personal level. [Find out more.](https://madmuseum.org/learn/book-private-tour-nike-form-follows-motion)

**Join a Private Gallery Talk and Walkthrough**

When the Museum is closed to the public, explore [*Nike: Form Follows Motion*](https://madmuseum.org/exhibition/nike-form-follows-motion) with our expert guide and Nike sneaker collector. [Purchase tickets.](https://madmuseum.org/calendar?t=Tour)

## Group Visits

MAD offers discounted admission to groups of ten or more visitors. To inquire about booking a group visit, please email <tours@madmuseum.org>.

## **SCHOOL GROUPS**

MAD offers onsite and virtual field trip programs for students K-12. [Learn more](https://madmuseum.org/learn/youth-school-groups)

## **THE MAD MOBILE GUIDE**

Available on Bloomberg Connects, the MAD Mobile Guide puts the entire Museum in the palm of your hand. Access an audio guide for [*Nike: Form Follows Motion*](https://madmuseum.org/exhibition/nike-form-follows-motion)*,* as well as a Museum map, audio and video stories highlighting MAD's permanent collection, and a key to collection objects installed throughout the Museum—all designed to enrich your visit to MAD.

#### Accessibility

\+

The Museum is fully accessible for visitors with wheelchairs and wheelchair-accessible seating is available for all MAD events.

All floors of the Museum are accessible by elevator. The Museum lobby is on the ground level with direct access to the street via one automated door. Accessible, gender-inclusive restrooms are located on the Theater Level and Floors 6 and 7.

Manual wheelchairs are available free of charge on a first-come, first-served basis at the admissions desk in the lobby.

The Theater at MAD supports Assisted Listening Devices (ALDs), which are available upon request. The door to the Theater is propped open during seating for public programs and there are no steps.

There is one door to enter the sixth-floor classroom, which is wheelchair accessible.

ASL-English interpretation is available for public programs and events upon request, contingent upon the availability of interpreters. To place a request, please contact <education@madmuseum.org>.

#### Enjoy Your Visit Safely

\+

If you are feeling ill, please stay home to safeguard your health and the wellbeing of others. If you are experiencing any of the following symptoms—fever of 100°F or higher, cough, shortness of breath, difficulty breathing, other respiratory symptoms, chills, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, or loss of taste and smell—please stay home. If you have been exposed to or diagnosed with Covid-19 in the fourteen (14) days prior to your visit, please stay home. You may rebook your ticket for a later date.

Smoking and e-cigarettes are not permitted anywhere within the building or outside the Museum.

Restrooms are located downstairs on the Theater level and on floor 6.

An inherent risk of exposure to the coronavirus (COVID-19) exists in any public space where people are present. People visiting the Museum of Arts and Design do so at their own risk as to any potential exposure. We will continue to monitor state, city, and CDC guidelines to inform the Museum’s operations.

#### In the Museum

\+

Food and drinks are not allowed in the galleries.

No luggage or large backpacks are permitted in the galleries.

Free self-service storage lockers are available for visitors.

All bags are subject to inspection.

Only small, collapsible umbrella-style strollers can be accommodated on the gallery floors.

Children must be supervised at all times.

Sketching is permitted only in pencil and only on paper that is 11" x 14" or smaller. No easels are permitted.

Non-flash photography is encouraged throughout the museum, with a few exceptions. Sometimes an artist chooses not to allow images of their work to be distributed outside of the museum. In those cases, we respect the artist's request, and we ask that you do as well. If you have any questions about which pieces are permissible to photograph, you can always ask a museum guard. No video or tripods please!

#### Parking

\+

MPG parking garage servicing The Shops Columbus Circle offers a special discount code to MAD Museum visitors. Enjoy a 15% discount on daily parking reservations. For more information, visit [mpgparking.com](https://mpgparking.com/attraction/deutsche-bank-center) and use promo code DBC to redeem this offer.
